description: Details pursuant to conditions 6 (demolition/construction works barrier), 11 (construction method statement) and 15 (wheel washing) of Non-material amendments reference 15/4719 dated 5 November, 2015, for Non-material minor amendment to insert condition allowing modification to conditions 1, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 15, 16 and 18 so far as they relate to land specified in the document titled "Section 96A Boundary Plan", of planning permission 12/0788, dated 09/11/2012, for Demolition of Keniston Press, Premier House, Cullen House and the Falcon public house and redevelopment of 137 flats (39 affordable), along with new public space, 1270 square metres of commercial space (Use classes A1/A3/A4) and 959 square metres of office space (Use class B1a for dedicated use by TfL) within a part 4, part 5, part 6, part 8 and part 9 storey building. Application includes the stopping up of the gyratory system and the introduction of a new signalled junction at Kilburn Lane and Salusbury Road/Carlton Vale
site_name: Ex Cullen House, Salusbury Road NW6, 313 & 341 Kilburn Lane, 50 Claremont Road W9 and car parks
